payload.friendly_name: Application-edge read path on the Pack model
payload.purpose_context: Until now the service only proved a persistence-through-domain round-trip; the application and API layers were placeholders on first-pass scaffolding. This mission builds the first real read path end-to-end on the single canonical Pack aggregate, reclassifies the application layer as an outer edge adapter that hosts the service concretizations, gives each layer its own composition configuration aggregated by a deployable entrypoint so modular wired tests are cheap, and removes the first-pass scaffolding outright so there is exactly one model.
payload.purpose_tldr: The charter service's first real functional read path, built on the one canonical Pack model with the application layer as an outer edge.

payload.question: Does this mission's functional scope cover only the READ path (list/get pack, context, info over the Pack model), or also wiring WRITE endpoints (save tactic/descriptor) through to HTTP?

payload.final_answer: Read-path only. Narrowed further: the new Pack-model read path covers TACTIC retrieval only; descriptor/DRG/other pack artefacts are not retrieved this mission (their read model is not yet ruled). Write ports stay unexposed to HTTP but their save contract is pinned by a port-level contract test.

options: Delete CharterPack + retire the not-yet-modeled endpoints
Keep CharterPack as bounded interim for those endpoints only
payload.question: Tactics-only is in scope, but pack-listing + action-context endpoints run on CharterOffering/CharterPack and their new models aren't ruled. How to reconcile with 'delete CharterPack outright'?

payload.final_answer: Delete CharterOffering/CharterPack/CharterPackRepository/FileSystemCharterPackRepository outright AND retire the pack-listing (PacksController/PackListingQuery) and action-context (ContextController/ActionContextQuery) endpoints plus ConsistentLoad, since their Pack-model read model is not yet ruled. Tactic retrieval becomes the only live read endpoint this mission; InfoController/ServiceInfoQuery stays. One canonical aggregate root, no coexistence. Removing those endpoints is an inbound REST contract change (handle the OpenAPI contract + regeneration in plan). pack-listing + action-context are a tracked follow-up mission once their models are ruled.

Delete the application purity rule outright (treat like infra)
payload.question: How to revise the ArchUnit gate for application-as-edge?

options: Rename bootstrap -> deployable (redistribute its wiring into per-layer configs)
New deployable package alongside; delete bootstrap
payload.question: How should the deployable composition root relate to the existing bootstrap package?
What create-vs-update contract should TacticRepository.save be pinned to?

payload.final_answer: Collection + single-by-id: GET /api/v1/packs/{packId}/tactics (all tactics of a pack) and GET /api/v1/packs/{packId}/tactics/{tacticId} (one). 404-class refusal when pack/tactic absent.

Replace APPLICATION_IS_PLAIN_JAVA with a positive APPLICATION_IS_EDGE rule: application may depend on domain, kernel and framework, but must NOT depend on another slice's infra, on storage internals of its own slice beyond the ports, on cross-slice domain, or on deployable. Keep a biting known-bad control (ReachesStorage-style).

Rename bootstrap -> deployable. deployable holds @SpringBootApplication + an aggregate DeployableConfiguration that @Imports each layer's own @Configuration. The current bootstrap wiring (CharterWiring/GuardWiring/PackPersistenceWiring) is redistributed into the per-layer configs. Retarget ONION_ONLY_BOOTSTRAP_COMPOSES_ADAPTERS and the NullMarked/other gate references from bootstrap to deployable.

Create-or-update (upsert): save creates the tactic when its id is unknown and replaces it when known. The filesystem adapter gains an atomic create arm (new file in the pack dir) alongside the existing atomic replace. Pinned by a port-level contract test covering both the create and the update arm. Write surface stays HTTP-unexposed this mission (C-006).
